title: Facade

act2.summary: two subsystems change their internals and one is replaced

solutions.title: One TripPlanner facade, two thin call sites
solutions.tradeoff: planTrip and printTripSummary each shrink to one line, delegating to a shared TripPlanner - a subsystem change or replacement gets edited once instead of once per caller. The price: neither caller can skip a subsystem or reorder the five calls anymore, and reading what a trip plan actually does now means opening one more file.

reviewFocus: Do trip-planning-api.ts and trip-summary-cli.ts import any of the five subsystems directly, or only TripPlanner?
If a third caller needed a fare estimate without checking alerts, could it get one without either bypassing TripPlanner or making every caller pay for all five subsystems?
Is ACT2.md honest that four of the five changed files are the same tax on both routes, and only trip-planner.ts is where the pattern's argument actually lives?
Would a plain module of functions - no TripPlanner class - have made the same argument, given the subsystems are built once and never reconfigured per call?
